title: Data-Oriented Programming homework and projects with disclosed LLM use
summary: Students complete eight Python homework assignments and two projects by fixing bugs and writing functions from scratch. They may use university-provided or external LLMs to explain and debug code, but must disclose the tool and its help, understand all submitted code, and remain responsible for correctness.

sources.title: Insights from Social Shaping Theory: The Appropriation of Large Language Models in an Undergraduate Programming Course
sources.evidence_quote: Each homework assignment (8 total) and project (2 total) asked students to fix bugs and/or create several functions from scratch

assessment.summary: Fix Python bugs and implement functions across eight homework assignments and two projects with optional, disclosed LLM support.
student_actions: Use LLMs selectively for explanation or debugging.

student_role.description: LLMs are permitted as collaborators for explanation and debugging, but complete-answer generation is discouraged.

prohibited_actions: Generate a complete answer without understanding it

grading.method: Course staff grade homework and projects; students are responsible for correctness and may receive zero for undisclosed copied work.
